name: Variable Basis Mapping (VBM)
definition: A framework that transforms volumetric fields into 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) representations through wavelet-domain analysis, enabling real-time volumetric visualization by avoiding prohibitively high computational costs of direct volume rendering.
summary: Variable Basis Mapping transforms volumetric fields into 3D Gaussian Splatting via wavelet analysis, avoiding the high costs of direct rendering by mathematically bridging wavelet atoms to Gaussian primitives.
